correctness.rationale: The general tree-flow dual norm formula is proved by telescoping and an attaining edge-sign potential. The automorphism average reduces arbitrary extensions to one scalar without assuming positivity. An explicit leaf potential and the root-edge current provide opposite-slope universal affine lower bounds. The optimizer lies strictly between zero and one, and direct absolute descendant-mass sums give exact attainment on both edge types. The threshold and strict parameter monotonicity follow by algebra; verify.py checks 49 pairs and all 1470 edge columns with exact rationals.
